ck_approvals_decided.name: ck_approvals_decided
ck_approvals_decided.value:
("radcore"."approvals"."status" = 'pending') = ("radcore"."approvals"."decided_at" is null)
    and ("radcore"."approvals"."status" in ('approved', 'rejected')) = ("radcore"."approvals"."decided_by" is not null)
    and ("radcore"."approvals"."decided_by" is null or "radcore"."approvals"."decided_by" <> "radcore"."approvals"."requested_by")

ck_exports_failure.name: ck_exports_failure
ck_exports_failure.value:
("radcore"."exports"."status" = 'failed') = ("radcore"."exports"."failure" is not null)
    and ("radcore"."exports"."failure" is null or "radcore"."exports"."failure" in ('too_large', 'failed'))

ck_exports_ready.name: ck_exports_ready
ck_exports_ready.value:
("radcore"."exports"."status" = 'ready') = ("radcore"."exports"."store_key" is not null)
    and (("radcore"."exports"."status" = 'ready') = ("radcore"."exports"."rows" is not null)) and ("radcore"."exports"."rows" is null or "radcore"."exports"."rows" >= 0)

ck_files_size.name: ck_files_size
ck_files_size.value: ("radcore"."files"."status" <> 'ready' or "radcore"."files"."size" is not null) and ("radcore"."files"."size" is null or "radcore"."files"."size" > 0)

radcore.v_schema_audit_columns.definition:
with audited as (
    select c.oid, c.relname,
      string_to_array(split_part(encode(g.tgargs, 'escape'), '\000',1), ',') as keys,
      string_to_array(nullif(split_part(encode(g.tgargs, 'escape'), '\000',2), ''), ',') as keep,
      string_to_array(nullif(split_part(encode(g.tgargs, 'escape'), '\000',3), ''), ',') as redact
    from pg_catalog.pg_trigger g
    join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid = g.tgrelid
    join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
    where g.tgname = 'audit_row' and not g.tgisinternal and n.nspname = 'radcore'
  ), columns as (
    select t.relname, a.attname,
      a.attname = any (coalesce(t.keep, '{}')) as kept, a.attname = any (coalesce(t.redact, '{}')) as redacted,
      a.attname ~ '(hash|secret|token|ciphertext|password)' and a.atttypid not in ('timestamptz'::regtype,
        'timestamp'::regtype, 'date'::regtype, 'bool'::regtype, 'int4'::regtype, 'int8'::regtype, 'numeric'::regtype) as secret_like,
      a.attname = any (t.keys || array['created_at', 'created_by', 'updated_at', 'updated_by']) as exempt
    from audited t
    join pg_catalog.pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = t.oid and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
  )
  select relname::text as table_name, attname::text as column_name, 'unlisted' as problem from columns
    where not exempt and not kept and not redacted
  union all
  select relname::text, attname::text, 'kept and redacted' from columns where kept and redacted
  union all
  select relname::text, attname::text, 'a secret not redacted' from columns
    where secret_like and not redacted
radcore.v_schema_audit_columns.name: v_schema_audit_columns

radcore.v_audited_tables.definition:
select c.relname::text as table_name
    from pg_catalog.pg_trigger g
    join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid = g.tgrelid
    join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
    where g.tgname = 'audit_row' and not g.tgisinternal and n.nspname = 'radcore'
radcore.v_audited_tables.name: v_audited_tables

radcore.v_schema_enums.definition:
select n.nspname::text as schema_name, t.typname::text as type_name
  from pg_catalog.pg_type t
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = t.typnamespace
  where t.typtype = 'e'
    and n.nspname not in ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pgboss', 'drizzle', 'ratelimit') and left(n.nspname, 3) <> 'pg_'
radcore.v_schema_enums.name: v_schema_enums

radcore.v_schema_fk_without_index.definition:
select n.nspname::text as schema_name, c.relname::text as table_name, k.conname::text as constraint_name
  from pg_catalog.pg_constraint k
  join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid = k.conrelid
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where k.contype = 'f'
    and n.nspname not in ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pgboss', 'drizzle', 'ratelimit') and left(n.nspname, 3) <> 'pg_'
    and not exists (select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_index i
      where i.indrelid = k.conrelid
        and array_to_string((i.indkey::int2[])[0:cardinality(k.conkey) - 1], ',') = array_to_string(k.conkey, ','))
radcore.v_schema_fk_without_index.name: v_schema_fk_without_index

radcore.v_schema_missing_audit.definition:
select n.nspname::text as schema_name, c.relname::text as table_name
  from pg_catalog.pg_class c
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where c.relkind in ('r', 'p') and not c.relispartition
    and n.nspname not in ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pgboss', 'drizzle', 'ratelimit') and left(n.nspname, 3) <> 'pg_'
    and (select count(*) from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
      where a.attrelid = c.oid and not a.attisdropped
        and a.attname in ('created_at', 'created_by', 'updated_at', 'updated_by')) < 4
radcore.v_schema_missing_audit.name: v_schema_missing_audit

radcore.v_schema_missing_triggers.definition:
select n.nspname::text as schema_name, c.relname::text as table_name, t.name::text as missing
  from pg_catalog.pg_class c
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  cross join (values ('stamp_who_when'), ('audit_row')) as t(name)
  where c.relkind in ('r', 'p') and not c.relispartition
    and n.nspname not in ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pgboss', 'drizzle', 'radcore_ext', 'ratelimit')
    and left(n.nspname, 3) <> 'pg_'
    and not (t.name = 'audit_row' and n.nspname = 'radcore'
      and c.relname in ('audit_log', 'access_log', 'event_log', 'saved_once', 'jobs_outbox', 'webhook_deliveries', 'sessions',
        'change_reasons'))
    and not exists (select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger g
      where g.tgrelid = c.oid and g.tgname = t.name and not g.tgisinternal)
radcore.v_schema_missing_triggers.name: v_schema_missing_triggers

radcore.v_schema_numeric_without_check.definition:
select n.nspname::text as schema_name, c.relname::text as table_name, a.attname::text as column_name
  from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
  join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where c.relkind in ('r', 'p') and not c.relispartition and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
    and a.atttypid = 'pg_catalog.numeric'::pg_catalog.regtype
    and n.nspname not in ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pgboss', 'drizzle', 'ratelimit') and left(n.nspname, 3) <> 'pg_'
    and not exists (select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_constraint k
      where k.conrelid = c.oid and k.contype = 'c' and k.conname = 'ck_' || c.relname || '_' || a.attname)
radcore.v_schema_numeric_without_check.name: v_schema_numeric_without_check

radcore.v_schema_public_relations.definition:
select n.nspname::text as schema_name, c.relname::text as table_name
  from pg_catalog.pg_class c
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where c.relkind in ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') and n.nspname = 'public'
radcore.v_schema_public_relations.name: v_schema_public_relations
